lastRequest: Build a fully working ATS Resume Scanner web application. REQUIREMENTS: (1) Real PDF and DOCX resume upload using react-dropzone - the file handler must use FileReader or pdfjs-dist to extract text from the uploaded file. (2) Real ATS score calculation: extract keywords from the resume text, count matches against the job description, and compute a percentage - the score MUST change based on what is uploaded. (3) Real job description text area where the user pastes a job posting. (4) Keyword matching: show which keywords from the job description are found vs missing in the resume. (5) Score breakdown chart using Recharts reading from real computed state - categories: Keywords, Skills, Experience, Education, Formatting. (6) Recommendations list derived from the actual analysis. (7) Scan history saved to localStorage - each entry stores filename, score, date. (8) Export analysis as PDF using jsPDF or window.print. STRICTLY FORBIDDEN: hardcoded scores, Math.random() metrics, setTimeout fake loading, static chart arrays. Use React with Vite, Tailwind CSS, dark theme.

tasks.title: Project Setup and Domain Architecture
tasks.description: Initialize React TypeScript project with Tailwind CSS, configure project structure, and define core TypeScript interfaces for resume parsing and ATS scoring models.

tasks.title: Document Parsing Engine
tasks.description: Implement client-side document processing for PDF and DOCX files using robust text extraction libraries without server dependencies.

tasks.title: ATS Scoring and Keyword Analysis Algorithm
tasks.description: Build heuristic matching engine to evaluate resume text against job descriptions, calculating keyword density, formatting score, and section completeness.

tasks.title: Interactive Dashboard and UI Components
tasks.description: Develop responsive Tailwind CSS dashboard featuring drag-and-drop file upload, real-time score visualization, keyword gap analysis, and optimization suggestions.

tasks.title: Testing, Optimization and Validation
tasks.description: Perform end-to-end testing, optimize text extraction performance, ensure WCAG accessibility compliance, and validate ATS scoring accuracy.
